raw.setBoundary: Use the user’s described wake-up times for Tuesdays and Thursdays and any baseline wake-up time needed to compute/interpret “15 minutes earlier.”
raw.missingRisk: The Tuesdays/Thursdays wake-up is described only as “15 minutes earlier” (relative), so the answerer must combine it with the baseline wake-up time (e.g., 7:00 AM) to determine the exact clock time. If the baseline differs on those days, the computed time may be wrong.
